_comment: Example NapCat OneBot-11 config. The WebUI (http://127.0.0.1:6099/webui) is the authoritative way to set this; this file documents the shape the openclaw-onebot plugin expects. Live config lives at config/onebot11_<uin>.json (gitignored). Replace <ACCESS_TOKEN> with NAPCAT_ACCESS_TOKEN from .env (must match channels.onebot.accessToken on agent-lab-openclaw). messagePostFormat MUST be 'array'.
